images/000000494973.jpg: The bird sits very still on that pale slanting branch. Light catches the blue wing and white head against almost black leaves; that contrast is lovely.
images/000000049458.jpg: The men are posed shoulder to shoulder with armfuls of animals. All those dangling legs overlap in the middle; the black-and-white treatment and their steady gaze make it feel like a serious portrait.
images/000000117789.jpg: The wet dog faces us with its tongue hanging out while a little wave curls behind it. The goofy, endearing face is almost the whole picture against that open stretch of water.
images/000000516947.jpg: The heron stretches its neck straight out over the water. There is a spare beauty to the pale ripples, gray plumage and one dark sweep of wood; the bird looks intent rather than playful.
images/000000171484.jpg: The giraffes stand spaced along the enclosure. Their long legs look planted, and even their spots blend into the subdued gray and brown of the walls.
images/000000323368.jpg: The small round bird has its toes curled around the twig. Its brilliant red face against the green blur is striking, and the motionless puffed-up little body is endearing.
images/000000398927.jpg: The bird looks tiny beside that towering column of seeds. The warm yellow light washes across almost everything, right down to the green rim it grips.
images/000000540057.jpg: The woman cups a tiny dog against her chest. Her hands around its little face make the scene feel tender and safe, despite all the competing bright reds, yellows and lettering behind them.
